demographics.title: Demographics & Citizenship
demographics.description: This information is required for eligibility determination.

races.nativeHawaiian: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

demographics.citizenshipInfoBanner: We ask about citizenship status for each household member to determine program eligibility. Non-citizens may still qualify for certain benefits.
demographics.notCitizenCallout: You may still qualify for emergency Medicaid and certain other programs. We'll use this information to determine what you're eligible for.
demographics.prucolInfo: PRUCOL (Permanently Residing Under Color of Law) applies to individuals who are known to immigration authorities but are not being pursued for deportation.
demographics.sivInfo: Special Immigrant Visa holders who served with U.S. forces may qualify for additional benefits including Medicaid and SNAP without a waiting period.
demographics.alienNumberHint: 9-digit number found on your immigration documents
demographics.dateOfEntry: Date of entry into the U.S.
demographics.hasSponsor: Do you have an immigration sponsor?
demographics.sponsorIncomeHint: This may be used to determine your eligibility for certain programs.
demographics.fiveYearResident: Have you lived in the U.S. for 5 or more years?
demographics.fiveYearResidentNote: Some programs require 5 years of continuous U.S. residency. Certain groups (refugees, asylees, veterans) may be exempt from this requirement.
demographics.tribalMember: Are you a member of a federally recognized tribe?
demographics.veteranLabel: Are you or your spouse a U.S. military veteran or active-duty service member?
demographics.disabilityLabel: Do you have a disability that limits your ability to work?
demographics.ssiLabel: Are you currently receiving SSI (Supplemental Security Income)?
demographics.fosterCareLabel: Were you in foster care at age 18 or older?
demographics.fosterCareNote: Former foster youth up to age 26 may qualify for Medicaid regardless of income.
demographics.taxFilingLabel: How do you plan to file taxes this year?
demographics.photoIdPrompt: Upload a photo ID to help verify your identity.
demographics.immigrationDocPrompt: Upload your immigration documents to verify your status.
